_comment: Packages deliberately not on their latest version, and npm overrides, each with the reason. `npm run maintenance` stays quiet about a held-back package until a version newer than `latestSeen` appears. Review this list every month (docs/maintenance.md).

typescript.reason: typescript-eslint 8.72.1 (the TypeScript linter) supports TypeScript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. Move to 7 when typescript-eslint supports it.

@types/node.reason: Must match the oldest supported Node.js (22). Newer types would let code use APIs that Node 22 does not have. Move when Node 22 support is dropped.

minimatch.reason: ESLint 10.14 and typescript-eslint 8.72 depend on minimatch 10, affected by GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (fixed in 11.0.1). Remove the override when they depend on >=11.0.1.
